title: Mechanism105 combat status, guard and record fragments
$comment: Typed fragments, not a replacement for complete configuration/snapshot validation. Cross references, live identity, sums and atomic lifecycle semantics are enforced by Rust and the shared Node/H5 decoder.

shield_record.$comment: recorded <= cap is checked by the Rust and shared Node/H5 decoders.

shield_balance.$comment: remaining <= granted; current maxHP does not bound previously granted balances.

status_requirement.$comment: Only instances created by the trigger owner qualify; consume <= at_least <= the referenced definition stack bound.

window_record.$comment: recorded <= cap and contact/record consistency are enforced by the shared Node/H5 decoder.

periodic_spirit_tick.$comment: hp_excess = spent_heal + remaining_excess; ceil/floor and current resource gaps are checked by Rust and public consumers.
